svg.text: Barista & Shift Lead at Sandstone Architecture

text.tspan: I keep a short thread on this. Running a shop
taught me more about cash flow than any
course.
The first hire needed clearer SOPs than I
thought I had.
My note back to the group was basically this.
Your calendar should include recovery, not
only openings.
Writing it down so I do not forget.
A quiet process beats a charismatic scramble.
I started closing the laptop at 8 so I still
have a life outside the business.
Document the job so the business is not
trapped in your head.

thought I had.
Your calendar should include recovery, not
only openings.
I wrote a simple refund policy and arguments
got shorter.
Ask for the review. Most happy people just
forget.
I batch admin on Wednesdays so the rest of the
week can be customer-facing.

forget.
Inventory mistakes are expensive teachers.

Ego products lost.
